title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 24 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. It affects a product that faces the internet or gives remote access.

category.label: VPN, firewall or gateway
category.why: It sits at the edge of your network and faces the internet, so attackers can reach it directly.
category.doThis: If you have it, patch it today. If you cannot, block access to it from the internet until you can.

summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 17, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
